description: This file defines the PdfCatalog class, representing the document catalog dictionary in a PDF. It manages properties like version, pages, outlines, viewer preferences, outlines, named destinations, AcroForm, language, and other catalog-related entries, offering methods for preparing and writing the catalog object. The class also includes an inner class for catalog keys, specifying PDF versioning and features.

classes.name: PdfCatalog
classes.description: Represents the PDF document's catalog dictionary, managing core document properties, page tree, outlines, viewer preferences, and other high-level settings.

methods.name: PdfCatalog
methods.description: Constructor initializing a new PDF catalog with a document.

methods.name: PdfCatalog
methods.description: Constructor initializing a PDF catalog from an existing dictionary.

methods.name: Version
methods.description: Getter and setter for the PDF version, with validation for supported versions.

methods.name: Pages
methods.description: Returns the collection of pages for the PDF, initializing and flattening page tree if necessary.

methods.name: PageLayout
methods.description: Gets or sets the page layout mode of the PDF.

methods.name: PageMode
methods.description: Gets or sets the page mode (thumbnails, outlines, etc.) of the PDF.

methods.name: ViewerPreferences
methods.description: Returns the viewer preferences dictionary for the PDF.

methods.name: Outlines
methods.description: Provides access to the document outline collection.

methods.name: Names
methods.description: Gets the name dictionary associated with the PDF.

methods.name: Destinations
methods.description: Provides access to named destinations within the PDF.

methods.name: AcroForm
methods.description: Returns the AcroForm dictionary for form data and annotations.

methods.name: Language
methods.description: Gets or sets the natural language code for the document content.

methods.name: PrepareForSave
methods.description: Prepares objects within the catalog for saving, e.g., pages and outlines.

methods.name: WriteObject
methods.description: Writes the catalog object to the PDF writer, setting page mode if outline exists.
